Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Yasia Ivero: 37-year-old woman, 182 cm (tall), clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: soft rectangular face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: one clipped color panel. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette rust-charcoal. Visible personal details: one shaped cloth clasp. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: deliberately tousled but clean. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
